Lena (CSM): Heads up — LaunchPad org showing ~60% drop in daily inference calls since Monday. New PM (Jordan) started last week; procurement is doing a feature/price bakeoff with CompetitorX. Need a rapid triage before renewal deck lands. :warning:
Omar (AM): Ack. Do we have a time window for decision from procurement?
Lena (CSM): They hinted at EOW for internal shortlist. Dashboard link: https://redwood.dash/launchpad/overview — summary below:
```
Wk start: DAU 12.3k -> 4.8k
Top routes: /generate (down 58%), /embeds (flat)
Active seats: 42 -> 40 (no big churn)
Error rate: 0.3% -> 0.4% (normal)
```
Kai (Solutions Eng): Quick question — are they hitting latency/budget alarms that would push them to CompetitorX? Any logs?
Lena (CSM): Not latency; cost appears to be the ask. Procurement flagged token cost for high-volume generation routes. Also PM is testing few hallucination cases and flagged one false-positive in their safety eval.
Nina (RevOps): I can run a quick cost delta for CompetitorX vs our recommended batching/quantization profile. If we can show 20–30% unit cost improvement with config + a short canary, that could swing them. I have a slot at 3pm PT.
Omar (AM): Good. Kai — can you prepare a short list of config changes (batching, KV cache, quantization profile) + expected cost delta and risk notes? 20 min deck.
Kai (Solutions Eng): On it. Will include a before/after token-per-gen calc and any expected latency impact. Will also note the safety eval mitigation (small prompt tweak + rerank) for the hallucination case.
Lena (CSM): I'll own the customer comms and set expectation for a canary. I'll ask Jordan (new PM) for the hallucination repro and share with Kai.
eng-alert-bot: [deploy] Canary pipeline for launchpad-cfg/experiment-31 started by kai at 2024-08-13T14:12:30Z
Omar (AM): Great. Nina — if you can surface the contract renewal date and any clause for price/benchmark SLAs that would help.
Nina (RevOps): Renewal window: 2025-02-14. They have a 30-day notice clause for pricing adjustments. I'll pull the contract excerpt and post in thread before 3pm.
Lena (CSM): Plan + owners:
- Kai: config list + cost delta (3pm PT)
- Nina: contract excerpt + cost comparison (3pm PT)
- Lena: reach out to Jordan, schedule 30m canary sync and collect hallucination repro (by EOD)
- Omar: prep exec-facing 1-pager for procurement (by EOW)
Any objections? :eyes:
Kai (Solutions Eng): No objections. Will flag any nontrivial quality tradeoffs in the deck.
Omar (AM): Solid. If competitor offers deeper model fine-tuning, we should call that out as a timeline risk.
Lena (CSM): Noted. I'll emphasize speed-to-value for our canary + fallbacks.
Lena (CSM): Quick ask — if we get green on cost delta, can we offer a 4-week dedicated trial with reserved instance + bundled observability at a discount to lock them in? (proposed owner: Omar)
Omar (AM): Yes, we can propose that. I'll draft terms after Nina posts the contract bit.
Lena (CSM): Thanks team. I'll update this thread after 3pm with findings and next actions. :thumbsup:
